title.zh: 泰国SEC批准比特币和以太坊ETF在泰国证券交易所上市
title.en: Thailand finalizes rules paving way for Bitcoin, Ether ETFs

current_state.zh: Thailand's SEC approved rules effective Oct. 16 that let local asset managers launch bitcoin and ether ETFs on the Stock Exchange of Thailand under tightened custody, concentration, and investor-protection requirements.
current_state.en: Thailand's SEC approved rules effective Oct. 16 that let local asset managers launch bitcoin and ether ETFs on the Stock Exchange of Thailand under tightened custody, concentration, and investor-protection requirements.

updates.title_zh: Thailand finalizes rules paving way for Bitcoin, Ether ETFs
updates.title_en: Thailand finalizes rules paving way for Bitcoin, Ether ETFs
updates.what_changed_zh: Thailand's SEC finalized rules allowing Bitcoin and Ether ETFs to list exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand starting October 16, 2026, while barring retail access to overseas crypto ETF products.
updates.what_changed_en: Thailand's SEC finalized rules allowing Bitcoin and Ether ETFs to list exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand starting October 16, 2026, while barring retail access to overseas crypto ETF products.
